citations.locator: Standalone native-loader matrix diagnostic, 64x64x64 and four execution groups: FP16, BF16 and FP32 IEEE tl.dot each passed five finite input distributions with unchanged input bits and complete 4096-element outputs per case against a presealed CPU float64 dot rounded to FP32 (atol 0.001, rtol 0.0001). Maximum absolute errors were 6.103515625e-05, 6.103515625e-05 and 0.000152587890625, respectively. This is bounded instruction/ABI evidence, not all shapes, looped accumulation, timing or registered-task qualification. Raw arrays/specs and independent scalar-reference review: open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-parity-20260920/matrix-numerics-gpu-66dcc472-v1/ and matrix-numerics-prepared-66dcc472-v1/. TF32 failed its separate RNE10 hypothesis and remains unadmitted; direct FP8 dot failed LLVM lowering. Neither mode is substituted for IEEE.

citations.locator: mcDeviceGetAttribute(mcDeviceAttributeL2CacheSize=38) reports 8388608 bytes, matching torch device properties L2_cache_size. Native SDK activity API version18 exposes Kernel8 timestamps/correlation and records zero dropped activity in the retained diagnostic. Raw observations: open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-parity-20260920/native-profiler-result.json and torch-profiler-result.json. Capacity is a hardware fact, not proof of cache-reset effectiveness or timing qualification.

Standalone native-kernel diagnostic under the shared MACA user lock: all six FP32/FP16/BF16 cast directions plus INT32-to-FP32 matched the standard-library RNE reference bitwise over 717114 inputs, including every finite FP16/BF16 source pattern, FP32 midpoint neighbors, signed zero, overflow/underflow and INT32 boundaries. MACA libdevice.tanh (CUDA-compatible entry mapped to maca_mathlib, not NVIDIA's implementation) had maximum 2 ULP against math.tanh rounded to FP32 on 82097 finite samples, with signed zero and input bits preserved. This is bounded diagnostic evidence, not a global error proof or a Workload receipt. Raw expected/observed bits and sealed artifacts: c550-1:/root/.local/share/open-cake-ir/metax-c550-20260920/primitive-f1cadbdd-v3.tar.gz; local open-cake-ir-evidence/metax-numerics-20260920/primitive-results/. No timing or profiler qualification.
